confidence_notes: Food, coffee and beer anchors have moderate support: Spain-wide and Andalusian 2026 averages plus a few Cádiz menu examples. Beer is priced as a caña-size draft, and the inexpensive meal as a basic menu-style lunch. Cocktail and wine anchors are weaker because Cádiz-specific data was thin. They rest on other Spanish cities and undated guides, cross-checked against the beer anchor. Accommodation anchors are model estimates for July peak season from general knowledge, not checked against live listings or searches. EUR prices were converted to USD at an approximate, unverified rate. FX is stale: the latest RBA figure I could confirm is dated 2026-03-20, taken from a search-indexed copy of the RBA page. Refresh it before any AUD conversion.
comparable_city_reasoning: Andalusian and Spain-wide 2026 averages for set lunches and coffee, with Cádiz menu examples. Beer, wine and cocktail anchors are benchmarked to Jerez de la Frontera, Alicante, Granada, Salamanca and Madrid price points. Accommodation is based on general knowledge of Andalusian coastal summer rates.
